definitions.gloss: milt; fish sperm sac; soft roe
definitions.explanation: The sperm sac of male fish, considered a delicacy in Japanese cuisine. Most commonly from cod (tara) or pufferfish (fugu), it has a soft, creamy texture and mild flavor.

examples.japanese: {白子|しらこ}のポン{酢|ず}{和|あ}え。
{冬|ふゆ}は{鱈|たら}の{白子|しらこ}がおいしい{季節|きせつ}だ。
examples.english: Winter is the season when cod milt is delicious.

examples.japanese: {白子|しらこ}は{見|み}た{目|め}で{敬遠|けいえん}する{人|ひと}もいるが、{食|た}べてみるとクリーミーで{濃厚|のうこう}な{味|あじ}わいがある。
examples.english: Some people are put off by the appearance of milt, but when you try it, it has a creamy, rich flavor.

notes:
Written with the characters {白|しら} (white) and {子|こ} (child/offspring), referring to the white, soft appearance of the sac. A seasonal winter delicacy, especially prized from {鱈|たら} (cod) and {河豚|ふぐ} (pufferfish). It is the male counterpart to {卵|たまご}/{魚卵|ぎょらん} (fish eggs/roe).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鱈|たら}の{白子|しらこ}: cod milt
- {河豚|ふぐ}の{白子|しらこ}: pufferfish milt
- {白子|しらこ}ポン{酢|ず}: milt with ponzu
- {白子|しらこ}の{天|てん}ぷら: deep-fried milt
- {白子|しらこ}{鍋|なべ}: milt hot pot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {卵巣|らんそう}/{真子|まこ}: roe, ovary — the female counterpart; fish eggs
- {数|かず}の{子|こ}: herring roe — a specific type of fish roe eaten at New Year
- たらこ: cod roe — salted cod eggs, a common food item

USAGE:
The word {白子|しらこ} can also refer to a person or animal with albinism, though this usage is less common in modern Japanese.
